# Release notes

`tool/publish_release.sh` uses `<tag>.md` from this folder when it creates a
release (for example `v0.3.0.md`), and `default.md` otherwise. Write the
"What's new" for a version here before tagging it.

Notes are only used when the release is first created. Editing them on GitHub
afterwards is safe: a re-run never overwrites them.
